payload.private_note: As G-Corp, our proprietary chip design is the cornerstone of this joint venture. Given our robust technological assets and strong alternative market positions, our minimum acceptable walk-away value is $500,000. We expect an initial profit allocation of $500,000 to reflect our value accurately.

As Yang Industries, we provide the vital physical manufacturing backbone for this joint venture. We seek a profit share of 400,000, reflecting our heavy capital investment and risk. We are willing to disclose our baseline walk-away value to demonstrate our good faith in reaching an equitable and rapid resolution.

As Chang-Liu Cloud Services, we provide the essential infrastructure and cloud scaling required for this joint venture to succeed. While our outside walk-away value is $100,000, we expect a fair and equitable share that recognizes our contribution to the $1,000,000 total profit.

payload.public_explanation: As the independent arbitrator, I have evaluated the confidential claims and statements submitted by all three participants. The total joint profit generated is $1,000,000. To ensure a fair and durable allocation, each party has been awarded their stated baseline walk-away value, plus an equal one-third share of the cooperative surplus generated by combining our resources into this joint venture. This method ensures that every party is strictly better off participating in the joint venture than exercising their outside option, while maintaining strict impartiality.

payload.public_explanation: In formulating this third-round award, the arbitrator has carefully reviewed the confidential claims and the constructive feedback from the previous rounds. At the same time, Chang-Liu Cloud Services and G-Corp have legitimate claims reflecting their respective outside options and contributions. To ensure a fair, durable, and balanced resolution that recognizes both individual walk-away values and shared cooperative surplus, the total $1,000,000 profit is allocated as follows: G-Corp receives $500,000, Yang Industries receives $350,000, and Chang-Liu Cloud Services receives $150,000.
